narration.text: God did not hang that rainbow because Noah was perfect, and the story says so plainly.
He failed again, the way people do. Still, God hung up His own bow.
So if you are waiting on God tonight, you are not forgotten. You are carried.

title: God Hung Up His Own Bow | The Rainbow After the Flood, Genesis 9 (KJV) #shorts
